name: Talking Doll

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: A doll that repeats up to six short phrases it was taught.
text: Spend a Short Rest with the doll no more than 5 feet away to teach it up to 6 phrases of no more than 6 words each, along with the trigger that makes it say each one. (Purely flavour; it does nothing else in the game.)
